Specification: This module specifies two basic combinatorial operators over natural numbers: a recursively defined factorial function and a binomial coefficient function choose(n, k). The specification is purely mathematical and contains no state variables, actions, temporal behavior, fault model, or verification properties. It extends Naturals in order to use natural-number arithmetic and defines choose in terms of factorial using integer division and multiplication.
IfThenElse: IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * factorial[n-1]
